businesses.business: physician enablement and value-based care platform

offering_description.value: Provides a technology, data and operations platform that helps independent physician practices and medical groups succeed in value-based care. Works with health systems, payers and employers; also offers care management and medical group services. Earns revenue mainly from physician-group operations and shared savings contracts.

primary_products.value: population health and practice management software platform; data analytics tools

primary_services.value: physician practice administrative and operational support; value-based care enablement; care management; accountable care organization management; medical group primary and specialty care

customer_segment.value: B2B: independent physician practices, medical groups, health systems and commercial payers; B2G: Medicare accountable care organization programs through CMS; B2C: patients receiving care through affiliated and owned medical groups

end_markets.value: healthcare delivery; value-based care; primary and specialty care; health insurance (Medicare, Medicaid, commercial)

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: fees for patient care at owned medical groups and shared savings from Medicare and payer ACO contracts; service fees: platform and administrative service fees from affiliated practices, often a percentage of collections; commissions or management fees: care management and population health management fees
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; service fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in practice, claims and clinical data and sells operational and value-based care services to physician groups and payers; software / platform: technology platform used by affiliated practices for population health and practice management; asset operator: operates owned medical groups delivering patient care
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; asset operator

geography_served.value: US national: Operates in many US states, including Arizona, Georgia, Texas, Maryland, Virginia, Tennessee and the Carolinas

specialization.value: related lines: physician enablement, ACO management, care management and medical group operations

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: business development with physician practices, health systems and payers; partners / resellers: partnerships with health systems and payers to build and grow provider networks

regulatory_exposure.value: high: healthcare delivery and Medicare ACO participation, CMS rules, Stark and anti-kickback laws, HIPAA, state medical practice rules

notes: Exact revenue mix between ACO shared savings, platform fees and owned medical groups is uncertain.
